text.text_excerpt: I was SO impressed while I was visiting Popbar in the French Quarter! I was very interested in how a gelato place that serves pops, shakes, and frozen lemonades would be in that location. I ordered the Vanilla Latte pop dipped in white chocolate with rainbow sprinkles, and it was delicious! All of their products are made in-house and the pops are pretty low calorie for ice cream (70-100 calories per pop without any toppings). Would definitely recommend this spot!

I went to Popbar Nola today and it's a nice small place right on N Peters. Wide variety of gelato, yogurt, fruit based Popsicles with several different topping options. Atmosphere -. Area is small so no seating available. You will have to ear the popsicle outside which in the summer heat means it starts melting immediately. I got 3 popsicles - toasted marshmallow, strawberry with sprinkles, and peanut butter with chocolate. Overall, the Popsicles were tasty! The toasted marshmallow tasted similar to toasted marshmallow ice cream. The peanut butter was VERY much like peanut butter and the strawberry was like throwing 10 strawberries in a blender and freezing. They were extremely delicious ...

I went to Popbar on a friday afternoon with a friend. It is right in the heart of the French Quarter and is a great spot for tourists to get a tasty treat. I got the toasted marshmallow popsicle half-dipped in dark chocolate with rainbow sprinkles. It was very tasty and rich-kind of like s'mores. . They have tons of flavors and i definitely struggled over what to order. My friend got a fruity popsicle, and I will probably try a fruit flavored one the next time I go. They also have milkshakes, lemonade, and other treats. There is no indoor seating, so you have to take your popsicle on the road.
